periods.time: Same day, from morning to dusk in Welf's workshop

name.zh: 韦尔夫将弥诺陶洛斯之角锻成【牛若丸】
name.en: Welf Forges Ushiwakamaru from the Minotaur Horn

periods.summary: Bell gives Welf the red-stained Minotaur horn he kept from his decisive battle. Welf recognizes that the horn has metallic properties, heats and hammers it like a rare material, and forges it into a translucent crimson short blade. Bell persuades him to use the name Ushiwakamaru rather than a worse pun, and Welf asks Bell to call him more like a companion before handing it over.
periods.cause: Welf promised Bell new equipment and Bell wants to preserve the Minotaur horn without wasting or selling it.
periods.process: Welf measures Bell, proposes using the horn, explains monster materials can have Adamant-like metallic traits, cuts and heats the horn, hammers it through the day, and finishes the blade at dusk.
periods.outcome: Bell receives Ushiwakamaru, Welf's best work to date, made from the Minotaur horn and fitted to Bell's hand.
periods.aftermath: Bell drops the stiff honorific and calls him Welf, confirming their growing companion bond.
periods.significance: Transforms Bell's Minotaur victory memento into a functional weapon and seals Bell and Welf's relationship as more than customer and smith.
